## TemplateEngine.\_validatePollItems() method

Validates `<g-question>` / `<g-option>` items inside `<g-poll>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _validatePollItems(template: string): Array<{
        line: number;
        message: string;
    }>;
```

Validation errors (empty when valid).

## Remarks

Enforces the Telegram `sendPoll` constraints: exactly one `<g-question>`<!-- -->, 2–10 `<g-option>` items, quiz-only `correct` (required, numeric, within the option range) and `explanation` (at most 200 chars), regular-only `multiple`<!-- -->. Static length limits (question 1–300 chars, each option 1–100 chars) apply only when the text carries no `{{}}` / `{~ ~}` interpolation — dynamic lengths are checked at runtime on the compiled strings. Called by [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGPollAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgpollattributes.md)<!-- -->; errors carry 1-based line numbers.
